identity.name: MonteCarloMultiGPU
identity.domain: European call option pricing by Monte Carlo, checked against analytic Black-Scholes

found_basis: Public executable CUDA sample, build/run commands and generated inputs are published in the named sources. Evaluator publication gaps are recorded separately.

outcome_definition.correctness: Average reserve > 1 and sample Test passed with successful process exit. Reserve averages Confidence / abs(BS - MC) over all options, adding only when abs(BS - MC) > 1e-6.
outcome_definition.confidence: Discounted 1.96 standard-error width; this is part of the algorithm, not an invented acceptance tolerance.
outcome_definition.l1: sum(abs(BS - MC)) / sum(abs(BS)); no published numeric target or threshold.
outcome_definition.performance: Total time (ms.) from sample and trusted invocation wall time; lower times indicate faster execution.

stock_cuda_image_feasibility.target_from_brief: Lambda Stack, Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA Toolkit 12.8, driver 570
requirements: CUDA Toolkit 12.8 development files including cuRAND
stock_cuda_image_feasibility.driver_requirement: Brief cites CUDA 12.8 GA Linux driver >=570.26. Exact installed patch not verified.
stock_cuda_image_feasibility.reason: Source/documentation compatibility only; no build or workload run. Actual GPU, toolkit and driver are not verified. Architecture list is hardcoded; do not assume override support.

memory.reason: At fixed timing scale, host option/results/BS arrays use 32 bytes/option; host pinned intermediates and device intermediates each use 24 bytes/option. Additional RNG allocation is gridSize*256*sizeof(curandState), gridSize=min(optionCount,40*SM_count). GPU geometry, RNG-state layout and runtime/evaluator overhead are not measured; complete peak is unavailable. Paths are generated in-kernel, not stored as a paths-by-options dataset.

scoring_rules.anchors: See anchors.json; strict reserve lower bound retains > comparison. Verdict maps Test passed to 1 and Test failed! to 0.
scoring_rules.rounded_boundary: At printed reserve 1.000000 use final verdict or unrounded statistic.

repeatability.limitations: Host rand depends on libc; GPU geometry changes random streams; GPU Boost affects timing. Duplicate A1 is a self-agreement arm, not an independent published anchor.
